# Justin He

> Portfolio and personal website of Justin He

## Blog

- [Leaving Tech to Build Something](https://www.justinhe.com/blog/creating-a-home-on-the-internet): A personal essay about quitting a tech job to pursue entrepreneurship and self-directed projects.

## Other

- [Claude Surf AI Development Tool](https://www.justinhe.com/projects/project-claude-surf): Opinionated orchestrator for Claude Code that streamlines autonomous software development with agentic features and workflow automation.
- [Color Theory Fundamentals](https://www.justinhe.com/a): Practice guide covering color wheels, perceptual dimensions, harmony schemes, and practical application principles.
- [Martian Ideas Through History](https://www.justinhe.com/b): Two centuries of human imagination about Martians, from canal theories to modern spacecraft discoveries.
- [The Shipping Container](https://www.justinhe.com/c): How standardized steel containers revolutionized global trade and enabled modern globalization economics.
- [Sourdough Science and Practice](https://www.justinhe.com/d): Detailed exploration of sourdough starter microbiology, fermentation chemistry, and baking techniques.
- [Ancient Eclipse-Predicting Mechanism](https://www.justinhe.com/e): Ancient Greek geared calculator from 150-100 BCE that predicted eclipses and tracked lunar cycles using sophisticated mechanical engineering.
- [Songbird Vocal Learning Neuroscience](https://www.justinhe.com/f): How songbirds learn to sing through sensory and sensorimotor phases, auditory feedback, critical periods, and regional dialects.
- [Map Projections Explained](https://www.justinhe.com/g): Why every flat map distorts Earth, what projections preserve, and why Web Mercator dominates online maps.
- [Bioluminescence Chemistry and Biology](https://www.justinhe.com/h): Explores cold light chemistry, deep-sea camouflage strategies, and bioluminescent organisms' evolutionary innovations.
- [Pokémon's Origins and Development](https://www.justinhe.com/x): How Satoshi Tajiri's childhood bug collecting in suburban Tokyo inspired the world's highest-grossing media franchise through six years of difficult development.
- [Pokémon Competitive Metagame](https://www.justinhe.com/y): How players built a complex competitive ruleset for Pokémon through datamining and community governance.
- [Pokémon Red Blue Generation One Glitches](https://www.justinhe.com/z): Exploration of famous bugs in Pokémon Red and Blue including MissingNo., the truck myth, and the Mew glitch.
